checked_at.description: When compliance.run last worked out its status; none before its first run.

checks.description: Each check, by frequency, with what it last said.

control.description: What the control holds, as Appendix F words it, without the PRD's revision tags.
examples: Payments and payee bank changes are dual-controlled

detail.description: In plain words, why: the worst check's words, or that each passed.
examples: 1 found in 2 approval(s) and 1 release(s) of the last day: Approved with the signature of whoever prepared it or asked for it

failing_since.description: While it fails or is overdue, since when.

frameworks.description: The frameworks it maps to, as frameworks names them.

items.description: A framework's key, as Controls.frameworks lists them.

frequency.description: How often it is checked, as Appendix F says.

mapping.description: Its mapping to the frameworks, as Appendix F words it, without the PRD's revision tags.

owner.description: The role that answers for it, and that a notice of its failure goes to.

status.description: The worst of its checks': fail, overdue, not assessed, pass; not applicable when none applies.
